title: Gradient flow towards quantum states with ideal quantum geometry
summary: We propose a gradient-flow method for quantum states in lattice models, generated by an action consisting of the quantum-metric and the square of the Berry curvature. These two terms drive the spectral projector toward Bogomolny saturation and uniform Berry curvature, respectively. We show that, due to a no-go theorem for finite-dimensional projectors, the two conditions cannot in general be satisfied simultaneously in lattice models.
